Evidence update from the deep sweep (2026-10-31): 108 new published tests, with losses on purpose. The base now holds 398 records: 269 wins, 35 losses, 14 nulls, 38 mixed.

- **Evidence base:** archives of Superwall, Adapty, RevenueCat, Sub Club, Growth Gems, Botsi, Purchasely, FunnelFox and others read through; every number read on its page. Losses and nulls with no figure are kept as anecdotal records: they show what didn't work and never enter a range.
- **onboarding-teardown:** tests #90–#167. Ranges rebuilt: flow length now shows the sign flip (shortened vs long −13% to +8%), paywall position, trial timeline, trial structure, sign-up timing, permission prompts and paywall echo gain rows.
- **upsell-teardown:** U52–U66 (free-tier size, hard paywall vs freemium, offer timing, tier upgrades, "Buy now" button).
- **web2app-teardown:** W54–W63 (link-out results, web paywall offers, sign-up fields).
- **cancel-flow-teardown:** C29–C31; **retention-teardown:** R62–R63 (stated losses and nulls).
- **variant-check:** paywall mechanics show the new single tests and their losses under "Where it flips" (Adapty bands unchanged). Onboarding mechanics rebuilt: flow length split into adding, lengthening, cutting steps and condensing reading screens; sign-up later, paywall position and paywall echo gain calls; a permission-prompt flow check. QA: 2 independent runs on 3 paywall and 3 onboarding briefs, all verdicts matched each other and the previous round; the rules they found unclear were fixed (one cap in total for missing traits, ties go to the higher low end, one tie-break order, overlap of annual hero and a new annual trial).
